description: The horizontal stacked bar chart illustrates the average rate at which two models attend to different input segments during generation. The vertical axis contains the model categories, ordered from top to bottom as "Ours" and "Standard," without a specific axis title. The horizontal axis represents the value as a percentage; it lacks an explicit axis label, tick marks, and tick labels, but spans an implied linear range from 0% to 100% based on the stacked components. Each horizontal bar is stacked with three color-coded segments representing different input segments, as indicated by a legend at the bottom: blue for "Context," orange for "Generated Response," and green for "Other." The segments are arranged from left to right in this order. For the "Ours" category, the bar consists of a blue segment annotated with 60.6%, an orange segment annotated with 31.7%, and a green segment annotated with 7.7%. For the "Standard" category, the bar comprises a blue segment annotated with 23.6%, an orange segment annotated with 51.1%, and a green segment annotated with 25.3%. Across the chart, the largest single segment is the blue "Context" segment in the "Ours" bar at 60.6%, while the smallest is the green "Other" segment in the same bar at 7.7%. The categories are not sorted in a specific numerical or alphabetical order, and visual emphasis is provided by annotating the exact percentage values directly within each corresponding colored segment.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the average rate at which the model attends most to each input segment: context, generated response, or other (e.g., system prompts) during generation. The vertical axis contains the categories labeled 'Ours' and 'Standard,' while the horizontal axis represents the percentage composition. Each bar is divided into three segments, with colors representing different categories: blue for 'Context,' orange for 'Generated Response,' and green for 'Other.' The 'Ours' bar is composed of approximately 60.6% Context (blue), 31.7% Generated Response (orange), and 7.7% Other (green). The 'Standard' bar consists of approximately 23.6% Context (blue), 41.1% Generated Response (orange), and 35.3% Other (green). Notably, the 'Standard' model demonstrates a significant decline in attention to Context compared to the 'Ours' model, while the attention to Other increases substantially. This suggests that the 'Standard' model prioritizes system prompts over contextual information during generation.
